eps.ov: Spica is trying to learn to become a master sorcerer. She has a long ways to go.
Claude comes up with a training plan for Spica, but it puts her in a bit of a bind.
Spica makes new friends at Diana Academy. She starts by getting Io Taurus out of a bit of a hole.
The class is tasked with collecting mandrakes, when Io and Spica end up in a bit of a bugbear.
Spica is preparing for her midterm exam. Meanwhile, Claude is looking for a student leader for the coven.
The students are tasked with raiding a gryphon's nest.
Spica and Hana join forces against the gryphon, but their combined magic might not be enough to pass.
Spica and her coven-mates begin training with Claude at the camp.
The Claude Coven begins Professor Hercules's training, which consists of a duel between covens.
Spica and the others finish their training, but a mysterious girl detains her.
The coven attempts to escape from Arc and Rigel, and Chiron comes up with an idea.
The confrontation with Arc and Rigel continues and concludes.
Claude tells Spica the truth about the day of the attack on Diana and the capital.

eps.t: Maids at the House of Regulus
eps.ov: Thanks to the part-time job Spica landed at the Regulus House, she gets to know Leo better.
Astrea asks Claude for help, and Spica practices her new powers.
Io wants to be a helpful member of society, but things don't quite work out. Claude offers her volunteer work.
Finals are here, giving Spica and the other midterm flunkers a chance to redeem themselves.
Claude Coven is on an island to complete their finals. Spica ends up in a bit of a sticky situation.
Spica competes with Capella, Leo, and Ewe to retrieve a ruby from a demonic bird's beak.
Spica's in the lead for now, but she needs to do more to stay ahead.
Spica and Aria duke it out over the diamond.
There's a reason Aria is so put off by Spica's scholastic ambitions, and it isn't anything to do with her.
Claude is too cat to announce the end and results of the finals, so Principal Jeanne arrives to lend a hand.
Claude takes Spica to town to buy her a new wand, but she ends up looking for herself instead.
